dashboard.label: Explorer
dashboard.description: Find an asset by any of its key values, then see which source supplied each of its fields.

search.query: | inputlookup assetdb | eval adb_pat=lower(trim($adb_q|s$)), adb_pat=if(len(adb_pat)=0, ".*", replace(replace(adb_pat, "([.^$$|()\\[\\]{}+?\\\\])", "\\\\\\1"), "\\*", ".*")) | where if(adb_pat=".*", true(), mvcount(mvmap(asset, if(match(lower(asset), adb_pat), 1, null()))) > 0) | eval adb_seen=coalesce(tonumber(last_seen), 0) | sort 100 - adb_seen | eval adb_id=_key | `adb_icon` | fields - adb_pat adb_seen _mkv_child

| inputlookup assetdb | fields _key asset | eval adb_pat=lower(trim($adb_q|s$)), adb_pat=if(len(adb_pat)=0, ".*", replace(replace(adb_pat, "([.^$$|()\\[\\]{}+?\\\\])", "\\\\\\1"), "\\*", ".*")) | where if(adb_pat=".*", true(), mvcount(mvmap(asset, if(match(lower(asset), adb_pat), 1, null()))) > 0) | stats count as adb_total
| rest splunk_server=local /servicesNS/nobody/assetdb/configs/conf-assetdb/general | fields lookups | spath input=lookups path={} output=src | mvexpand src | spath input=src | table name lookup
